Vivid Sydney returns for its 15th year for 23 consecutive nights from Friday 23 May to Saturday 14 June and will be lighting up 5 key zones across the city.

The city is no place for cars with road closures and clearway parking restrictions in place each night in Circular Quay, The Rocks, Dawes Point, Millers Point and Ultimo until 1am on Saturday nights.

Road closures - Saturdays:

  • *CLOSED* From 3pm roads in The Rocks, Millers Point and Dawes Point including sections of Lower Fort St, High St, High Ln and Argyle Pl, and in Ultimo sections of Systrum St, Mary Ann St and Omnibus Ln. For the Rocks Markets, George St is closed between Lower Fort St and Hickson Rd. 
  • *CLOSED* From 5pm roads including sections of Bridge St, Grosvenor St, George St, Argyle St, Harrington St, Hickson Rd, Pottinger St, Merriman St, Rodens Ln, Essex St, Upper Fort St and Watson Rd. In Circular Quay including Pitt, Loftus, Young, Albert and Phillip Streets . No east/west access across the city via Bridge St - use alternative routes. Sections of Erskine St westbound and Kent St southbound are also closed.
  • *CLOSED* From 5.30pm a section of Darling Dr south of Pier St in Ultimo.
  • From 7pm Wheat Rd at Darling Harbour will close until 11pm.

Special event clearways are in effect on various roads between 3pm and midnight on key roads in the Sydney CBD, The Rocks, Circular Quay, Dawes Point and Haymarket.

Clearways are strict no-parking zones for all vehicle types, and apply even to local residents and TfNSW Mobility Scheme Permit holders. Check signs carefully as vehicles left in clearways will be towed and a fee applies. If your vehicle is towed, you can search your vehicle registration at the Find My Car website to find its new location, or alternatively call 132 701 to speak to an operator.

Special Event Clearways are strict no-parking zones for all vehicle types, and apply even to local residents and TfNSW Mobility Scheme Permit holders. Check signs carefully as vehicles left in clearways will be towed and a fee applies. If your vehicle is towed, you can search your vehicle registration at the Find My Car website to find its new location, or alternatively call 132 701 to speak to an operator.
